classes.a_same_fact_serialized_twice: catalog row p resolves to an identical value inside the non-catalog envelope (path identity)
classes.b_distinct_equal_value: different canonical paths whose serialized value happens to be equal
classes.c_alias: the row points at a value the compaction pass already renamed (per_candidate_reference / candidate_targets_reference / *.value)
classes.d_catalog_material: the catalog is the only carrier of that fact on the wire
classes.e_contract_required: overlap flag: the path name is named by the role prompt and must survive any compaction

interpretation: total_calibrated_tokens is the whole catalog row (id+p+v+c+punctuation) per class; total_value_only_calibrated_tokens is the ``v`` payload only, i.e. what a pointer/dereference rewrite can remove while keeping every citable id and path
